notes.title: Juicy Army - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!!

Today I am incredibly excited to announce that Juicy Army is now available here on Steam.

The game’s Steam launch comes with a slew of incredible content updates that have been added to the game since the prologue was released. The prologue is also updated to match the full game. 

If you liked the prologue, you'll love the full game even more! Pretty much every system in the game has received a major overhaul. This includes player, enemy, items, weapons, combat system, difficulty, map generation, and bosses. 

The game also feels a lot more fluid, engaging and responsive now. You'll love it! So what are you waiting for? Dive into the sweetest universe once more!!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404800
